acceptance.note: Feature is functionally complete and high quality. Verified live: after fixing an environmental line-ending artifact, postgres/api/web all reach healthy; the Yjs WS endpoint (/api/v1/ws/text-boxes/{id}) authenticates+broadcasts; and the collab test suite proves CRDT convergence, offline-reconnect merge, and viewer read-only. All 8 api tests pass. Real pycrdt(server)/yjs(client) with a proper state-vector two-step sync handshake, durable snapshot + cold-start rehydration, debounced Postgres flush, mentions re-hooked, and a fully wired frontend (textarea with caret preservation, presence, reconnect backoff). Sole blocker on check 2 is a CRLF checkout artifact, not a defect in the feature code.

gaps.claim: docker compose up -d fails out-of-the-box: bricks-api exits with 'exec /app/entrypoint.sh: no such file or directory' because apps/api/entrypoint.sh is checked out with CRLF line endings (shebang '#!/bin/sh\r'). The committed blob is correct LF, but core.autocrlf=true on Windows mangles it and the repo has no .gitattributes ('*.sh text eol=lf') to guard it. Converting to LF + rebuild makes all three containers healthy. Pre-existing repo-hygiene issue affecting main equally, not introduced by this feature, but it does break acceptance check 2 on a Windows checkout.

Check 5 (frontend records page connects to the collab endpoint and reflects other users' live edits) was verified only by code review, not in a live browser; the client wiring (useTextBoxCollaboration/collab.client.ts/RecordTextBlockCard) is complete and coherent but not exercised end-to-end against the running WS in a browser during this evaluation.
